scenes.script: The worst quarter in years. Then, the best since twenty-twenty. Same market — ninety days apart.
scenes.headline:
90 DAYS.
TOTAL
WHIPLASH.

scenes.script: First, the storm. The Iran conflict sent oil from sixty-one dollars to one-eighteen. The S&P dropped four point three percent. The Nasdaq, seven. Bitcoin? Down nineteen.
scenes.label: Q1 · JAN–MAR · THE STORM
scenes.headline:
FIRST,
THE STORM.

scenes.script: Then, the flip. Q2: the S&P surged fourteen point nine percent — its best quarter since twenty-twenty. The Dow ended at a record.
scenes.label: Q2 · APR–JUN · THE COMEBACK
scenes.headline:
BEST QUARTER
SINCE 2020.

big.caption: S&P 500 · Q2 2026 — Dow at a record

scenes.script: But Bitcoin missed the party. Thirteen straight days of ETF outflows. Sixty-seven thousand, down to sixty. While stocks rallied, crypto de-risked.
scenes.label: THE ODD ONE OUT
scenes.headline:
BITCOIN
MISSED IT.

scenes.script: And the fuel wasn't hype. It was earnings. Profit forecasts jumped from eighteen point eight, to twenty-three percent.
scenes.headline:
EARNINGS,
NOT HYPE.

scenes.script: From storm, to surge. That's the quarter, over the quarter.
scenes.headline:
STORM,
THEN SURGE.
